decisions.decision: Keep T-339 open as the one input task for T-133; nothing more can be built around it. Stop re-running T-133 on the unattended runner, which has no browser. Cross-link T-339 with T-350 (same Twilio sign-in) and T-115 (same desktop session) so one sitting by Adi clears all three. In that session: first check Tantra and Twilio access in the Brave profile adi@growthclub.org. Capture WhatsApp slots 1, 2 and 4 from Tantra (template preview, template screen with Marketing category and 1,024-character limit, campaign scheduler) and SMS slot 3 from the Twilio console (draft with merge fields). Draft only, never save or send, blur numbers and names, and log anything created in the revert ledger. Then run check-guides, commit, merge, publish the mirror, close T-133 and T-339, and continue with the T-115 captures and the T-283 Twilio re-record.
